warnings: *** REWRITTEN AFTER A-13 WAS READ - THE FIXTURE NUMBERS ARE NOW RESOLVED. *** This file first recorded 7 fittings by their circled digit alone with fixture_type_not_resolved, because neither A-11 nor A-12 prints a legend. A-13 (หน้า14) carries รายละเอียดสุขภัณฑ์ห้องน้ำ, a ten-row table keying every digit. Those entries have been renamed to the scheduled fixture and their flags cleared; the printed digit is kept in printed_as and the source of the name is stated on each element. The earlier reading is recorded here rather than deleted, per the append-or-rewrite rule - it is the honest record that this sheet alone could not identify them.

*** THIS SHEET CONFIRMS THE ห้องน้ำ 2 NAMING INFERRED ON A-05, AND THE INFERENCE WAS RIGHT. *** A-05's upper-floor plan labels one bathroom ห้องน้ำ 1 and leaves the other simply ห้องน้ำ; that file recorded the second as ห้องน้ำ_2 by elimination and flagged it. A-12 is titled ขยายห้องน้ำ 2 and labels the room ห้องน้ำ 2 +3.95 in full. The three bathrooms in the set are therefore 1 and 2 upstairs and 3 downstairs, matching the A-11/A-12/A-13 sheet titles exactly.

THE LEVEL IS +3.95 HERE, AGREEING WITH A-05, A-08 AND A-11's SECTION. That is now four occurrences of +3.95 for an upper-floor bathroom against the single +3.90 on A-11's plan, which is flagged on that file.

THE ROOM SPANS THE FULL GRID 2 TO GRID 3 BAY - the plan's top chain is 1.10 + 0.10 + 0.40 + 0.40 under a printed 2.20, matching the master's 2.20 m bay. The side chain is 0.80 + 0.40 + 0.20 + 0.50 + 0.50 with 1.70 printed as a sub-total.

FIXTURE NUMBERS ARE CIRCLED DIGITS WITH NO LEGEND ON THIS SHEET EITHER - the same 1 to 10 keying as A-11, and A-12 carries no key for it. Only the icons that are unmistakable are named; the rest keep their printed number with a flag. Neither A-11 nor A-12 contains the schedule, so it is either on A-13 or in the SN set, or the drawings simply omit it.
This file is one of three views on หน้า13 per §3; the others are รูปตัดขยายห้องน้ำ ข and แบบขยายธรณีประตูห้องน้ำ.
